entities.name: Jama Masjid Gulbarga
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Jama Masjid, also known as the Friday Mosque of Gulbarga, the Great Mosque of Gulbarga Fort, and formally as the Jamia Masjid - Qila-e-Hasham, is a Friday mosque located in Kalaburagi, in the state of Karnataka, India. The mosque is located within the Gulbarga Fort complex, in Kalaburagi.
